### Contributing guidelines

- [X] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

### Module(s)

mini.basics

### Question

```
    | *     | Visual          | Search forward for current visual selection   |
    | #     | Visual          | Search backward for current visual selection  | ]]
```

How can I use the above keymap to achieve something like this:
```
-- Search current
vim.keymap.set({ 'n', 'v' }, '*', '*N', { desc = 'Search current' })
vim.keymap.set({ 'n', 'v' }, '#', '#n', { desc = 'Search current' })
```

Basically (no pun intended :p), I want to "highlight" all visual selection but stays at the current location, until I hit `n` or `N` again.

comment_data.body:
> Basically (no pun intended :p), I want to "highlight" all visual selection but stays at the current location, until I hit `n` or `N` again.

No harm in a little pun :)

Currently there is nothing like this in 'mini.basics'. The mappings for `*` and `#` themselves are only created on Neovim=0.9, since they are [good enough on Neovim>=0.10](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/a95dc67ecff78de138543a20c20f29f47111b122/doc/mini-basics.txt#L247-L248).

I do find myself needing this type of behavior occasionally, so I guess it might be a good idea to try to add to 'mini.basics'. However, the problem is (as always in this type of situations) is to find a good future-compatible. I currently don't really like the idea of overriding `*` and `#` themselves.

Not sure. Some thinking time is required :)

reply_data.body:
Thanks, did not realise this behaviour is built-in now. Do you know if there is anyway for me to "hook" onto the default "*" mapping and add another mapping?

Something like:
```
vim.keymap.set('x', '*', function()
      return _visual_search(1) .. 'N'
    end, { desc = ':help v_star-default', expr = true })
```

I tried with `remap=true` and it didn't work also.

reply_data.body:
> Thanks, did not realise this behaviour is built-in now.

It (mappings for to search a visual selection) was built-in for a very long time (since Neovim=0.8). Just that on Neovim<0.10 it had some issues, that's why it was a part of 'mini.basics'.

> Do you know if there is anyway for me to "hook" onto the default "*" mapping and add another mapping?

Apart from doing some hacking (get the function that is used as mapping RHS and use it directly), I don't think so. Default mappings are done [as any regular mappings](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/3e8a4e10920dc6431547035eec514cdd21e37a3a/runtime/lua/vim/_core/defaults.lua#L51-L97), so this might work.
